title: Triangle String Bikini Set with Tie-Side Bottoms
description:
A classic two-piece with sliding triangle cups and ties at the neck, back and hips, so you can set the coverage and fit exactly the way you like it.
• Fabric: 82% polyamide, 18% elastane; fully lined
• Sliding triangle cups with removable soft pads
• Tie-side bottoms with moderate rear coverage
• Hand wash cold, rinse after swimming in salt or pool water and dry in the shade

title: Underwire Bikini Set with Adjustable Straps and High-Waist Bottoms
description:
A supportive black bikini that pairs a lightly moulded underwire top with high-waisted bottoms sitting comfortably at the natural waist.
• Fabric: 80% polyamide, 20% elastane; fully lined
• Underwire cups, adjustable shoulder straps and a three-row hook fastening at the back
• High-waist bottoms with full rear coverage
• Hand wash cold and dry flat away from direct sunlight

title: Ribbed Bandeau Bikini Set with Detachable Halter Strap
description:
A textured rib-knit bikini in sunny yellow. The strapless bandeau top turns into a halter neck with the strap that comes in the set.
• Fabric: 85% polyamide, 15% elastane stretch rib; lined
• Bandeau top with silicone grip edging and removable pads
• Mid-rise bottoms with cheeky rear coverage
• Hand wash in cold water; do not tumble dry

title: Colour-Block Push-Up Bikini Set, Black and Pink
description:
A two-tone bikini with contrast pink trims and a gently padded push-up top that adds shape without an underwire.
• Fabric: 80% polyamide, 20% elastane; lined throughout
• Wire-free push-up cups with adjustable straps and a tie back
• Low-rise bottoms with a contrast waistband
• Hand wash cold; rinse after every swim in the pool or sea

title: Scoop-Back One-Piece Swimsuit with Tummy-Control Front Panel
description:
A clean, sporty one-piece with a low scoop back and a double-layer front panel that smooths the midsection. Made for swimming lengths as much as for lazy beach days.
• Fabric: 78% polyamide, 22% elastane with a chlorine-resistant finish
• Built-in shelf bra with removable cups
• Medium leg cut and full rear coverage
• Machine wash at 30°C on a delicate cycle in a laundry bag

title: Ribbed Square-Neck One-Piece Swimsuit with High-Cut Leg
description:
A minimalist ribbed swimsuit with a square neckline, slim adjustable straps and a leg-lengthening high cut, offered in chocolate brown or white.
• Fabric: 82% polyamide, 18% elastane soft rib; fully lined, so the white is not see-through when wet
• Adjustable shoulder straps and removable cups
• Moderate rear coverage
• Hand wash cold and dry flat in the shade

title: Printed Kaftan Beach Cover-Up with V-Neck and Side Slits
description:
A loose, floaty kaftan in a blue patterned print that slips on over swimwear and works just as well for beach bars and holiday evenings.
• Fabric: 100% viscose, lightweight and quick to dry
• Relaxed fit with a V-neckline and wide batwing sleeves
• Length approx. 120 cm in size S/M, with side slits for easy walking
• Hand wash cold or machine wash at 30°C on a gentle cycle

title: Crochet Knit Beach Cover-Up Dress, White
description:
An open-weave crochet dress that layers over a bikini or swimsuit, letting the breeze through while keeping your beach look pulled together.
• Material: 100% cotton crochet knit, unlined
• Long sleeves, round neckline and a relaxed straight fit
• Length approx. 95 cm in size M
• Hand wash cold and dry flat to keep its shape

title: Men's Quick-Dry Swim Shorts with Mesh Lining and Drawcord
description:
Lightweight swim shorts in a fast-drying fabric for swimming, beach games and poolside lounging, with an elasticated waist and drawcord for a secure fit.
• Fabric: 100% polyester shell with a polyester mesh brief lining
• Elastic waistband with internal drawcord
• Two side pockets plus a back pocket with hook-and-loop closure
• Inside leg approx. 15 cm in size M; machine wash at 30°C

title: Men's Floral Print Board Shorts, Knee Length with Zip Pocket
description:
Longer-cut board shorts in a bold tropical floral print, made from a stretch fabric that moves with you in the surf, on the sand or along the promenade.
• Fabric: 92% polyester, 8% elastane four-way stretch; unlined
• Flat front waistband with lace-up tie fly
• Zipped side pocket with an internal key loop
• Outer leg length approx. 51 cm in size W32; machine wash at 30°C and do not iron the print

title: Toddler Short-Sleeve Swimsuit with Back Zip, UPF 50+ Fabric
description:
An all-in-one swimsuit for little ones with short sleeves and a back zip, so it is quick to put on and covers more skin at the beach or pool.
• Fabric: 82% polyamide, 18% elastane rated UPF 50+
• Back zip with a soft fabric zip guard and flat seams
• Blue with a white polka-dot print
• Rinse in fresh water after use and dry in the shade

title: Girls' Floral Ruffle One-Piece Swimsuit with Crossover Back
description:
A cheerful floral swimsuit for girls with ruffle trims on the straps and a lined front for comfortable all-day splashing.
• Fabric: 85% polyester, 15% elastane; front lined
• Ruffled shoulder straps and a crossover back
• White with a red and pink floral print
• Hand wash cold; rinse after swimming in chlorinated water

title: Striped Flat-Weave Cotton Beach Towel with Tassels, 100 x 180 cm
description:
A striped hammam-style towel that is thinner than terry, so it dries fast and folds small, yet is big enough to stretch out on.
• Material: 100% cotton flat weave
• Size: 100 x 180 cm with knotted tassels on both short ends
• Doubles as a sarong, picnic throw or light summer blanket
• Machine wash at 40°C; gets softer with every wash

title: Microfibre Quick-Dry Beach Towel with Pouch, 160 x 80 cm
description:
A lightweight microfibre towel that soaks up water quickly, shakes free of sand easily and packs down to roughly the size of a water bottle.
• Material: 80% polyester, 20% polyamide microfibre
• Size: 160 x 80 cm; folds into the matching drawstring pouch included
• Corner hanging loop for drying
• Machine wash at 40°C without fabric softener

title: Woven Straw Beach Tote Bag with Faux-Leather Handles
description:
A roomy woven tote with sturdy handles that takes a towel, sunscreen, a paperback and a water bottle with space to spare.
• Material: woven paper straw body with faux-leather handles
• Size: approx. 45 x 32 x 15 cm; handle drop 22 cm
• Cotton inner lining with a zipped pocket and magnetic snap closure
• Spot clean only and keep out of heavy rain

title: Striped Canvas Beach Bag with Woven Straw Base
description:
A bright striped canvas shoulder bag set on a woven straw base, for a playful pop of colour on the way to the beach or the market.
• Material: cotton canvas body with a woven straw base
• Size: approx. 40 x 30 x 14 cm; shoulder straps 60 cm long
• Drawstring top closure and one inner slip pocket
• Spot clean the base; the canvas can be gently hand washed in cold water

title: Packable Wide-Brim Straw Sun Hat with Adjustable Inner Band
description:
A wide-brim straw hat that shades your face and neck on bright days, with a flexible weave that can be gently rolled into a beach bag.
• Material: woven paper straw with a soft inner sweatband
• Brim width approx. 11 cm; crown height approx. 10 cm
• Fits head sizes 56–58 cm via an inner drawstring
• Reshape by hand after packing; spot clean only

title: Adjustable Cotton Sun Visor with Wide Peak
description:
An open-top visor that keeps the sun out of your eyes while letting heat escape. Handy for beach walks, padel or a day of sightseeing.
• Material: cotton twill peak with a terry-lined sweatband
• Peak length approx. 9 cm
• Hook-and-loop back strap fits head sizes 54–60 cm
• Hand wash cold and air dry

title: Striped Beach Umbrella with Tilt and Sand Anchor, 180 cm
description:
A classic striped beach parasol with a push-button tilt and a screw-in sand anchor that keeps it steady in soft sand.
• Canopy: 180 cm diameter polyester with UPF 50+ coating and a wind vent
• Two-part aluminium pole, height adjustable up to approx. 210 cm
• Includes sand anchor and a carry bag with shoulder strap
• Close and take down in strong wind; do not leave open unattended

title: Inflatable Flamingo Pool Float, 120 cm
description:
A giant pink flamingo float for lounging in the pool or on calm water, with a tall neck to lean against and quick-inflate valves.
• Material: 0.25 mm PVC; approx. 120 cm across when inflated
• Two safety valves for fast inflation and deflation; repair patch included
• Ages 14+; maximum load 90 kg
• Not a life-saving device: use only under supervision and in water where the user can stand
